title: Halifax Hop On Hop Off Bus
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Customers must be able to navigate an 8" high step
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore Halifax your way on colourful vintage London double-decker buses with a convenient Hop-On Hop-Off pass. Enjoy a 60-minute loop with 7 stops at top sights like the Maritime Museum of the Atlantic, Halifax Citadel, Public Gardens, and Fairview Lawn Titanic Cemetery. Every ride includes live commentary from a local guide with stories, history, and insider tips. Stay onboard for the full narrated tour or hop off anytime to explore the waterfront, downtown, museums, viewpoints, and shopping, dining, and entertainment areas.

STOPS:
1. Cruise Terminal / Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21
2. Maritime Museum of the Atlantic / Halifax Boardwalk
3. St. Mary’s Basilica / Shop & Dine
4. Halifax Public Gardens / Shop & Dine
5. Halifax Citadel National Historic Site
6. Fairview Lawn Cemetery / Titanic Grave Site
7. Art Gallery of Nova Scotia / Province House / Shop & Dine
